label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
text: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide. / If you decide to SURF, you could end up swept away somewhere else.$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
text: See, isn't it neat? These houses are on water! / I was born here!$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
text: The SKY PILLAR? / …Oh, you must mean that tall, tall tower a little further out. / If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. It's too scary to get up that high. / Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, that suits me fine.$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN / “Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.”$

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
text: That seaside cottage is where MR. BRINEY lives. / He was once a mighty sailor who never feared the sea, however stormy.$

label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
text: The sea, huh? / I wonder what it's like at the bottom of the sea?$

label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
text: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL, weaken the wild POKéMON first. / It will be easier to catch if it's been poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.$

label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
text: You're a thief if you try to steal someone else's POKéMON. / You should throw POKé BALLS only at wild POKéMON.$

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
text: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER. / But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes, it's a challenge to battle. / If you don't want to battle, stay out of their sight.$

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
text: I found this LEAF STONE beneath the flowers! Some GRASS POKéMON evolve when exposed to it. You should have it!$

label: Route104_Text_LeafStoneExplanation
text: That LEAF STONE can evolve certain GRASS POKéMON. Use it when ready.$

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
text: I found this Leaf Stone among the flowers. You should have it!$

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
text: This FLOWER SHOP started selling saplings recently. / It made me so happy, I went overboard shopping. Where should I put them?$

label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
text: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
text: ROUTE 104 {RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
text: ROUTE 104 {UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$

label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
text: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP$

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
text: TRAINER TIPS / Trainer battles in HOENN are DOUBLE BATTLES. Prepare your first two partners together. / A good opening pair gives each POKéMON room to do its job.$

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! / DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with the MATCH CALL system, huh? / We should register each other so we can get in contact anytime.$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredMay
text: {PLAYER} registered MAY in the POKéNAV.$

label: Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex
text: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how's your POKéDEX coming along?$

label: Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle
text: Mine's looking pretty decent. So… How about a little battle?$

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
text: MAY: Oh, what's the matter? / Haven't you caught or raised your POKéMON very much? / That's not very good for a TRAINER!$

label: Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle
text: MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?$

label: Route104_Text_MayIntro
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! We've both found new partners since ROUTE 103. / Show me how your team works!$

label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
text: Yikes! You read that faster than me!$

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
text: MAY: You handle a team like you've done it for years. / But go talk to MR. BRINEY sometime. He and PEEKO aren't a “set”. They're friends. That matters here too.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
text: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}! / Cool, you had DEVON install the MATCH CALL system on your POKéNAV! / Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredBrendan
text: {PLAYER} registered BRENDAN in the POKéNAV.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? Have you filled in any pages yet?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
text: Me, I'm doing great! / Want to check out how good I am with a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
text: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have any confidence in your POKéMON?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
text: BRENDAN: What's up? Want to have a battle with me?$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}. Fresh TRAINER or not, I'm not going easy.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
text: Hmm… Fine. You saw it coming.$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
text: BRENDAN: You build well already. / Still. Watch MR. BRINEY with PEEKO some time. Not every partner is a piece on a board. Don't forget that part.$

label: Route111_Text_VialBlobGetBackHere
text: Blob! Stop goofing around and get back here! How did you get over there?$

label: Route111_Text_VialNurseNeedsHelp
text: Oh, no! My CHANSEY ran north! / Please bring Blob back. I'll improve your Poké Vial's capacity as thanks.$

label: Route111_Text_VialHealBall
text: Blob trusts this HEAL BALL. Follow the trail north and use it.$

label: Route111_Text_VialNurseWatching
text: Blob and I help travelers here. CHANSEY can be rather playful.$

label: Route111_Text_VialReplacementBall
text: You lost the HEAL BALL? Take another. Blob will recognize it.$

label: Route111_Text_VialBringBlobBack
text: Blob ran north along ROUTE 111. Please bring my CHANSEY home!$

label: Route111_Text_VialThanks
text: You caught Blob! Thank you! / Poké Centers will now refill your Poké Vial with two full charges.$

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
text: Hello! I take it you're a traveler. / How's this? What do you say to taking on our family of four in a series of POKéMON battles?$

label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
text: Is that so? Drop in, if you change your mind!$

label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
text: That's the spirit! I like you!$

label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
text: Aiyah! You're a lot tougher than I expected!$

label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
text: Hey, all! I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
text: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young? / You must be quite the TRAINER to beat my husband, though. / It's my turn to battle now!$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
text: Oh, gosh! I can't get over how strong you are!$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
text: There's a strong TRAINER here! This one's really strong!$

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
text: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow! / But I'm strong, too! Really! Honestly!$

label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
text: Huh? Did I just lose?$

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
text: This stinks… / …Snivel… Grandma!$

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
text: How dare you make my granddaughter cry! / For that, I'm going to smack you! Prepare to lose!$

label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
text: Kwah! You are strong… My granddaughter was right…$

label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
text: If you're not in any hurry, visit with us awhile.$

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
text: If you don't raise your POKéMON some more, it could be tough to keep winning up through the ranks. / I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR are far stronger than any GYM LEADER.$

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
text: I challenged the WINSTRATE family, but four matches in a row is tough going… They destroyed me.$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSignMauville
text: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign
text: “Our family's hearts beat as one!” THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign112
text: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign113
text: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113$

label: Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign
text: OLD LADY'S REST STOP “Come in and rest your tired bones.”$

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
text: TRAINER TIPS / One of the indicators of a POKéMON's powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for “SPECIAL ATTACK.” / Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL DEFENSE.”$

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
text: There should be a tower made of sand around here somewhere. / But for some reason, it can be seen sometimes, and sometimes not. / That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.$

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
text: The MIRAGE TOWER is visible! Beneath its first floor lies an older stairway. / Archaeologists say it reaches a fossil archive called SANDSTREWN RUINS.$

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
text: The tower collapsed, but its basement passage may still meet DESERT UNDERPASS. / That route leads into SANDSTREWN RUINS.$

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
text: MIRAGE TOWER is gone, but the ruins below remain. FOSSIL MANIAC's tunnel on ROUTE 114 now reaches DESERT UNDERPASS.$

label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
text: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…$

label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
text: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…$

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
text: Oh, no! / My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to ROUTE 111! / My uncle? He lives across from the bike shop in MAUVILLE.$

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
text: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE / “Scale the heights, you hot-blooded TRAINERS!”$

label: Route111_Text_DynamoGuardClosed
text: The trail north is closed for now. The power lines up to LAVARIDGE went down in the last storm. / WATTSON's crew is rewiring the route. Once his GYM certifies you with the DYNAMO BADGE, you're cleared to pass.$

label: Route111_Text_DynamoGuardTrigger
text: Hey! Not past the rope. The trail north is closed until WATTSON's crew finishes the power lines.$

label: Route111_Text_IRENE_LocalConversation
text: A picnic needs three things: Food, shade, and less SANDSTORM.$

label: Route111_Text_BECKY_LocalConversation
text: I came to admire the desert. The desert came into my shoes.$

label: Route111_Text_CursedStoneClue
text: That carved stone just east of me matches a Galarian YAMASK's slab. / Read it with a conscious Galarian YAMASK missing at least 49 HP from its maximum. It becomes RUNERIGUS. / You can return to the stone even after MIRAGE TOWER disappears.$

label: Route111_Text_CursedStone
text: A curse is carved into this stone. / Each conscious Galarian YAMASK in your party that is missing at least 49 HP can become RUNERIGUS here. / Let the stone call to your party?$

label: Route111_Text_CursedStoneUnchanged
text: The stone falls silent. Bring a conscious Galarian YAMASK missing at least 49 HP, without an EVERSTONE.$

label: Route117_Text_AudiniteGift
text: AUDINO often wander through these flowers. They're wonderful partners. / Take this AUDINITE. With a MEGA RING, it helps an AUDINO Mega Evolve.$

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
text: I left two compatible POKéMON at the DAY CARE, and they produced an EGG! / Center tutors handle moves. The DAY CARE is where new partners inherit traits.$

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
text: Aren't these flowers pretty? I love watching the POKéMON wander through them. / Lately, an odd one with a metal mask has been hiding in the grass. DEVON calls it TYPE: NULL. / With the KNUCKLE BADGE, you can find it here as a 1% wild encounter. SWEET SCENT raises that to 25%.$

label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
text: The air is tasty here!$

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
text: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN$

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
text: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
text: POKéMON DAY CARE “Let us raise your POKéMON.”$

label: Route117_Text_DYLAN_1_LocalConversation
text: Training tip: take a breath. That is also my swimming plan.$

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Good to see you. / Have you found new partners, or stayed with your favorites? / Either way, think about how they help one another. That's a team's strength. / Head north on ROUTE 119. Visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE on the way. / Ask its researchers about the weather. Then challenge WINONA in FORTREE. / I'll keep exploring. Let's compare discoveries next time.$

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
text: Hmm! A GOOD ROD is really good! / Wouldn't you agree?$

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
text: Hmm! We're of identical minds! / Hmm! Take this GOOD ROD!$

label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
text: Wherever there's water, try your luck at fishing.$

label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
text: Don't you like to fish?$

label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
text: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON with your GOOD ROD.$

label: Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyChallenge
text: A rod catches fish. A Trainer finds the battle hidden inside them. / Want to face my complete fishing team?$

label: Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyDefeat
text: You never mistook the little fish for the whole current.$

label: Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyAfter
text: MAGIKARP was the invitation. It was never the joke. / Every weak-looking lead can hide a plan.$

label: Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyDecline
text: No hurry. The river and my team will wait.$

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
text: With SURF registered and the BALANCE BADGE, a compatible party member can cross water. / It doesn't need SURF in its battle moveset. Partners can help in more ways than one!$

label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
text: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$

label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
text: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119$

label: Route118_Text_WADE_LocalConversation
text: That splash was a huge fish! Or my lunch. I hope it was a fish.$

label: Route118_Text_BARNY_LocalConversation
text: WAILORD took the bait once. I am still paying for the rod.$

label: Route121_Text_NurseOffer
text: MT. PYRE is a long climb. Shall I heal your party before you continue?$

label: Route121_Text_NurseHealed
text: All better. Keep your partners close on the mountain.$

label: Route121_Text_NurseDeclined
text: All right. SKITTY and I will be here if you need us.$

label: Route121_Text_RestoredSkitty
text: SKITTY: Meenya?$

label: Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre
text: Okay! We're to move out to MT. PYRE!$

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
text: Ahead looms MT. PYRE… / It is a natural monument to the spirits  of departed POKéMON…$

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
text: MT. PYRE PIER / …The sign is old and worn out. The words are barely legible…$

label: Route121_Text_SafariZoneSign
text: “Filled with rare POKéMON!” SAFARI ZONE$

label: Route121_Text_VANESSA_LocalConversation
text: My POKéMON posed for a portrait. The artist requested hazard pay.$

label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
text: I love GRASS-type POKéMON! / Do you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?$

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
text: Oh? / You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too, don't you? / I'm so happy, you can have this! It's a token of our friendship.$

label: Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon
text: I check trees with my GRASS-type POKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSign
text: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
text: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE Forbidden to the faint of heart. / A guardian's mark stands among these fields. Return with the FEATHER BADGE and inspect it.$

label: Route123_Text_BerryMastersHouse
text: BERRY MASTER'S HOUSE$

label: Route123_Text_KINDRA_LocalConversation
text: That shadow is following you. Most shadows do. Carry on.$

label: Route123_Text_JONAS_LocalConversation
text: My smoke bomb worked perfectly. Finding my lunch afterward did not.$

label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse
text: HUNTER'S HOUSE$

label: Route124_Text_SPENCER_LocalConversation
text: I keep a map in my swim trunks. It is mostly ocean now.$

label: Route124_Text_ROLAND_LocalConversation
text: CLAWITZER is a powerful swimmer. The brakes could use some work.$

label: Route124_Text_CHAD_LocalConversation
text: STOUTLAND found my lost goggles. I was wearing them. Good dog.$

label: Route125_Text_NOLEN_LocalConversation
text: I know a shortcut to the shore. First, decide which shore.$

label: Route125_Text_SHARON_LocalConversation
text: SLOWBRO never seems rushed. I am trying to learn from that.$

label: Route127_Text_JONAH_LocalConversation
text: Fishing teaches patience. This spot has a full curriculum.$

label: Route127_Text_AIDAN_LocalConversation
text: Birds never need a boarding pass. I think they are showing off.$

label: Route133_Text_VialNurseHelp
text: We were swept onto this island by Route 133's current. / May I borrow your help getting Chansey and me safely ashore?$

label: Route133_Text_VialNurseUpgrade
text: Thank you! Before we go, I tuned your Poké Vial one final time. / Centers will now refill three charges.$

label: Route133_Text_VialNurseDecline
text: We'll keep waiting for a safe opening.$

label: Route133_Text_VialChansey
text: Chansey!$

label: Route133_Text_FRANKLIN_LocalConversation
text: WALREIN offered me a ride. The seat was colder than expected.$

label: Route134_Text_HITOSHI_LocalConversation
text: Even MACHAMP takes a rest day. It rests four arms. I rest two.$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: I once handed out DRAIN PUNCH as a TM. / Now every POKéMON CENTER specialist teaches any legal move for free.$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
text: I'm having a hard time deciding if I should make my SKITTY evolve or not. / I only have to use this MOON STONE, but it's so hard to decide… / If I make it evolve, it will become much stronger. / But it will look so different, too.$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Miyao?$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
text: This NUGGET I found here… I suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing as how it has no other use.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
text: Fufufufufu. / I'm going to make everyone think I'm just a kid and let them play down. / Then, I'll shock them and grab the title!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
text: The tents share the same serious doubles competition. / FALLARBOR is my favorite place to visit between exhibitions.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
text: I heard something about some tent, so I came to camp out. / I didn't know that tents these days are so luxurious! / Since I'm here, I may as well try my hand at battling!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
text: SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! So you came out to this BATTLE TENT! / The people in these parts tend to be easygoing and laid-back. / But, you see, what I'm looking for are people with… / How should I say this? / Someone bursting with the desire and the drive to win. / If there were a TRAINER like that, I'd immediately… / Whoops! Never mind! Keep working at it!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
text: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your time with the likes of me, why not make a challenge?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionWelcome
text: Our challengers bring ideas from the mountains and far beyond. / This is a six-Pokémon doubles exhibition. You command every move and switch. / Your team uses the current cap. Difficulty sets opponent levels. Enter with six healthy partners?$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionRules
text: LOCAL DOUBLES EXHIBITIONS / Bring six healthy Pokémon, with no Eggs. Prepare freely before entering. / Three victories earn one local prize. Your party is restored after each exhibition. / These results are separate from the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT. You return to this lobby afterward.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh… I never should have let myself be conned into telling TEAM MAGMA where you can find METEORITES… / That METEORITE from METEOR FALLS… It's never going to be mine now…$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
text: Oh! Is that the METEORITE TEAM MAGMA took from METEOR FALLS? / Please, may I have it? I can offer this rare DAWN STONE in exchange.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseTakeThisDawnStone
text: This Dawn Stone is my thanks. Please put it to good use.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it. This is really, really great! / This is really going to help my research!$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but… I'm crushed with disappointment…$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
text: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that METEORITE? / I can offer this rare DAWN STONE in exchange.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
text: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS on ROUTE 114 with some people from TEAM MAGMA.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
text: Poor PROF. COZMO… He's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
text: Look at PROF. COZMO… He's so happy! I think it's cute.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_EventScript_MegaGift_CLEFABLITE_Text
text: Cozmo studies what falls from space. I notice who comes looking for it. / Clefairy gather around these stones. Take this one for its evolved form.$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_HisuianGoomy
text: METEOR FALLS has iron-rich stone. Level GOOMY to Lv. 40 or higher in its main entrance chamber for Hisuian SLIGGOO. / Elsewhere, GOOMY keeps its usual form. Either SLIGGOO evolves at Lv. 50 or higher when leveled in rain or fog.$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
text: Which CONTEST are you entering? Want a piece of advice? / In any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE CONTEST, I don't think they judge you only on cuteness in the first round. / You need to work out ways for raising POKéMON better.$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
text: I raised my POKéMON to be cute. / I found out you can put POKéMON in a CONTEST for cuteness! / I'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with loving care…$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
text: My POKéMON rules! / It's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute, and smart. It's complete! / I may as well go for wins in every single CONTEST.$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
text: POKéMON CONTESTS NORMAL RANK STAGE!$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: I used to reward patient POKéMON with the move PAYBACK. / The CENTER specialist teaches it now whenever the species can learn it.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_LuxuryBallBuildsFriendship
text: A LUXURY BALL helps a caught POKéMON grow friendly more quickly. / The right Ball can make team building feel like part of the adventure.$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
text: They don't seem to sell any winning strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT… / It seems one must rely on one's own wits after all…$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnLowerLevelPokemon
text: The NEST BALL works better on lower-level wild POKéMON. / It is one of several specialty BALLS sold around HOENN.$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
text: You can't consider yourself a real TRAINER if you don't have faith in your POKéMON. / Only those people who can believe in their battling POKéMON can win through to the very end.$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
text: The reason why anyone would visit VERDANTURF… / It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without saying. / Or is there somebody here that you came to see?$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_TradeHappiny
text: This {STR_VAR_2} needs a caring TRAINER. Trade a {STR_VAR_1} for it?$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_TradeComplete
text: Thank you. Friendship is the best training CHANSEY can receive.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_TradeDeclined
text: That's all right. A trade should never be rushed.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NeedRequestedMon
text: That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}. Please bring the partner we discussed.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_HappinyDoingWell
text: CHANSEY and DITTO at the DAY CARE can have a HAPPINY EGG.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
text: Let me see your POKéMON. I'll check to see how much it likes you. / Oh. Your POKéMON…$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
text: It adores you. It can't possibly love you any more. I even feel happy seeing it.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
text: It seems to be very happy. It obviously likes you a whole lot.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
text: It likes you quite a lot. It seems to want to be babied a little.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
text: It's getting used to you. It seems to believe in you.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
text: It's not very used to you yet. It neither loves nor hates you.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
text: It's very wary. It has scary viciousness in its eyes. It doesn't like you much at all.$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
text: This is a little hard for me to say… / Your POKéMON simply detests you. Doesn't that make you uncomfortable?$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
text: PIKACHU: Pika pika!$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_EventScript_MegaGift_RAICHUNITE_X_Text
text: A little Pichu can grow into a wonderful traveling companion. / This stone is for a Raichu. Friendship is where it all begins.$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
text: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, is the POKéMON LEAGUE. / The TRAINERS who gather there are all frighteningly well skilled.$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
text: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the rules say that you have to battle the ELITE FOUR all in a row. / If you lose to any of them, you have to begin your challenge again from the first one.$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_EventScript_MegaGift_GALLADITE_Text
text: Strength can be quiet. A Gallade uses its blades to protect others. / I think this stone belongs with someone who understands that.$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhatColorTrainerCard
text: What color is your TRAINER CARD? Mine's copper!$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnColonyOfCorsola
text: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of a colony of CORSOLA. / If I told you that, would you believe me?$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
text: The ancestors of the people in PACIFIDLOG were said to have been born on boats and then lived and died  aboard them. / I understand that they lived that way because they were searching for something.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
text: Er-hem! / I am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most important person, the CHAIRMAN's younger brother. / I'm here enjoying my vacation with POKéMON, yes, indeed.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AhYourPokemon
text: Ah! Your POKéMON…$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
text: It clearly likes you very much. / A POKéMON that bright deserves this SUN STONE, don't you think?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
text: Hmm… It's not bad, but it's also not good. / You, as the TRAINER, need to put in some more effort.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
text: It has a fierce look to it. / A POKéMON that intense deserves this MOON STONE.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
text: SUN and MOON STONES evolve different POKéMON. Use this one when ready.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodStoneInXDays
text: In {STR_VAR_1} days, I'll receive more evolution stones. / Come see me then, and I'll choose one that suits your lead POKéMON.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rurii
text: AZURILL: Rurii.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyWithTrainer
text: It appears to be very friendly with the TRAINER.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rururi
text: AZURILL: Rururi!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTrainerVeryMuch
text: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER very much.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon
text: People were saying they saw a POKéMON flying high above HOENN. / Is it flying around all the time? Doesn't it need to rest somewhere?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon
text: A sky POKéMON! A sky POKéMON!$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_WhereDidYouComeFrom
text: Where did you come from?$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
text: Yes? YES TOWN? / I've never heard of a place like that.$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
text: No? That doesn't make any sense. You have to come from somewhere. / Oh! Wait! You're not going to say you were born at the bottom of the sea?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
text: I couldn't settle on a team. Too many interesting choices! / Then I found this PRISM SCALE. Maybe you can put it to use.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainPrismScale
text: A Prism Scale evolves Feebas. Use it from the Bag when ready.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
text: I don't really like BUG POKéMON, but maybe I'll try using some for a change of pace. / Who knows, I might even get to like them!$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
text: The CENTER can prepare any legal set for free. Bring your own six and test them here.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
text: A new opponent every match! I keep leaving with another idea for my team.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionWelcome
text: The port brings together teams from every shore. / This is a six-Pokémon doubles exhibition. You command every move and switch. / Your team uses the current cap. Difficulty sets opponent levels. Enter with six healthy partners?$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExhibitionRules
text: LOCAL DOUBLES EXHIBITIONS / Bring six healthy Pokémon, with no Eggs. Prepare freely before entering. / Three victories earn one local prize. Your party is restored after each exhibition. / These results are separate from the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT. You return to this lobby afterward.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_PleasedToRateMonNickname
text: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER! I'm the fortune-teller of names! / I shall be pleased to rate your POKéMON's nickname.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_CritiqueWhichMonNickname
text: Which POKéMON's nickname should I critique?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is quite a fine name you bestowed. / But! What say you, if I were to suggest a slightly better name?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatShallNewNameBe
text: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}! / It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
text: I see. Do come visit again.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
text: Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}! / It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior! / How fortunate for you!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
text: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is! / This is a magnificent nickname! It is impeccably beyond reproach! / You'll do well to cherish your {STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
text: Now, now. That is merely an EGG!$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_EventScript_MegaGift_MALAMARITE_Text
text: An Inkay once watched me write its name while hanging upside down. / It left this curious stone behind. A Malamar should know what to do.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_FurfrouOffer
text: I style every FURFROU trim used by competitive TRAINERS. Want a new cut?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_FurfrouChoose
text: Choose the FURFROU you want styled.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_FurfrouComplete
text: All done! {STR_VAR_1} has a clean new competitive look.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_FurfrouInvalid
text: I can only style FURFROU, including one that already has a trim.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_FurfrouExit
text: Come back whenever FURFROU wants a different look.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetChairman
text: Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the POKéMON FAN CLUB! / Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally the most important! / No one can best me when it comes to raising POKéMON. No one! / Well, let me tell you about POKéMON CONTESTS. / They're events where one can show off POKéMON for the world to see! / However, they're held in far-off towns, so I cannot participate often enough. / That is why we gather here to show off our POKéMON, and have others show us theirs.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeToSeeEnteredContestPokemon
text: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has entered a POKéMON CONTEST… That, I would like to see.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowMeToExamineYourPokemon
text: Er-hem! I see you've participated in a POKéMON CONTEST! / Please! Allow me to examine how you have raised your POKéMON. / It delights me no end to see POKéMON raised by other TRAINERS. / The happy expressions of POKéMON raised with proper care… / The kindly eyes of the TRAINER that nurtured and raised the POKéMON… / The very thought fills my heart to overwhelming with joy. / Oh! I do beg your pardon! Forgive me for prattling on so! / Please! Allow me to examine how much your POKéMON has grown!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsYourPokemonGrowing
text: How is your POKéMON growing? Allow me to examine it.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HmHmISee
text: Hm, hm… I see…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
text: Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not good, either… / You, the TRAINER, must put more effort into raising this POKéMON! / For instance, may I suggest that you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpaceForReward
text: Oh, my… / Your POKéMON is growing quite well, so you deserve a reward. / Unfortunately, you have no space for this in your BAG.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMostImpressiveGiveItThis
text: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in a most impressive manner! It is one fine specimen! / But! If you were to give it this, it would grow even better! Indeed!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainRedScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF. / Everyone will recognize the coolness of that POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBlueScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF. / Its beauty will be accentuated much more than now!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainPinkScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF. / It will draw out the cuteness of the POKéMON some more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainGreenScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF. / That will enhance the smartness of POKéMON!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainYellowScarf
text: Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF. / It will bolster your POKéMON's toughness so much more!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NothingElseToGiveYou
text: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to give you! None at all! / After all, you're blessed with the gift of raising POKéMON without resorting to any items!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMePokemonThatLoveYou
text: I love seeing POKéMON that love their TRAINERS. / POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS. / If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back. / When your POKéMON grow to love you, please come show me.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonAdoresYou
text: Your POKéMON really adores you. / For you, a most compassionate TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatPokemonWithLove
text: POKéMON are very sensitive to the feelings of their TRAINERS. / If you treat your POKéMON with love and care, they'll love you back.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PokemonDontLikeFainting
text: If you keep letting a POKéMON faint in battle, it'll come to resent it. / Soon, it will become less trusting of the TRAINER. / In other words, it certainly won't like you very much.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnjoyedLuxuryBall
text: Do POKéMON remember how they were caught? / Mine became friendly so quickly after I caught it in a LUXURY BALL.$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Fffnyaaaah…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Kyuuu…$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Marimari?$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
text: Woohoo! / I hear people call me the ROCK SMASH GUY, but I find that sort of degrading. / I think I deserve a bit more respect, like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE. / Woohoo! / Anyways, your POKéMON look pretty strong. / I like that! Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
text: That HM registers ROCK SMASH as a field technique for your team. / If you come across large boulders that block your path… / Well, use that HM move and smash them right out of your way! / Yes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say! Woohoo!$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
text: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON could come flying out of hiding. / Woohoo!$

text: Exchange your Coins for {STR_VAR_1}?$

text: {STR_VAR_1} arrived battle-ready! / Its moves, nature, Ability, and item match a competitive set.$

text: That unique prize has already been claimed.$

text: Starters cost 500 Coins each. Which region should I open?$

text: That battle set is unavailable. No Coins or prize claim were used.$

text: This is MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.$

text: Okay, you wanted some COINS for the games? / But you don't have a COIN CASE for stowing the COINS.$

text: Were you looking for COINS? / It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS. Would you like some?$

text: Thank you very much! Here are your COINS!$

text: Um… You don't appear to have enough money…$

text: Oh? Your COIN CASE is full.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
text: Oh… You don't need COINS, then? Good luck on your adventure!$

text: Welcome. / You can exchange your COINS for prizes here.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
text: Which prize would you like?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
text: Thank you! We'll send it to your PC at home.$

text: There isn't any room available for placing {STR_VAR_1}.$

text: Oh, is that so?  You need to save some COINS before coming back here.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
text: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?$

text: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
text: Here you go!$

text: Huh? You want it, but not right now?$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
text: Oh, don't be so negative! You can have this!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
text: There's a prize I want, but I can't win the jackpot.$

text: Hey, kid, if you want to play here, you need a COIN CASE. / I think the young lady next door had one. Go see her!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
text: My luck can only last so long. This is too much for me. Here, take some COINS!$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
text: MAUVILLE has something for everyone. / For me, it's the GAME CORNER.$

text: The ROULETTE tables have different rates. / Check your COINS if you're going to pick a table.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
text: It's easy to lose track of time in here.  I should get back to work.$

text: COINS are needed to play here in the GAME CORNER.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
text: This ROULETTE thing… It's rather demanding. / Win or lose, it's only by luck.$

text: Up to three COINS can be used to play the SLOTS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
text: It's very difficult to make it stop right on “7.” / If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
text: Here's some information for you about the SLOTS. / The more lightning bolts you stock, the more REEL TIME chances you get. / In a game with the maximum five REEL TIME chances… / It is possible to receive four regular bonuses, then a big bonus. / That would total 660 COINS, but it's very difficult to get.$
