text: You can't play if you don't have a COIN CASE.$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_AlreadyCaughtLegendary
text: You have already befriended this legendary Pokémon. / Your Coins have not been spent.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowMeCompletedDex
text: I'm the GAME DESIGNER. / Oh, is that right? You're working on a POKéDEX? / It's tough trying to complete it, but don't give up. / If you do complete it, please come show me.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_BuffelChallenge
text: I helped design battles where every role hands momentum to the next. / Want to test one of my favorite teams?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_BuffelDefeat
text: You've given me something to think on!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_BuffelAfter
text: The best battle is difficult, readable, and different from the one before it.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_BuffelDecline
text: Return when you want a designer's test.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_FilledPokedexGiveYouThis
text: Wow! That's awesome! Yep, it's totally awesome! / This POKéDEX is completely filled! You really must love POKéMON! / I'm so impressed! / Let me give you something in recognition of your feat!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
text: Me? You're talking to me? I'm the PROGRAMMER. / I wonder what the SLOTS are like here.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
text: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the POKéMON of HOENN interesting?$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_GirlsAreCute
text: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey? To battle against a cute TUBER… / Whoop, it's so awesome! / And the TWINS! Aren't they cute? A 2-on-2 battle with TWINS… / Whoop, it's unbearably fun!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBreezeTicklesHeart
text: The sea breeze tickles my heart. It feels wonderful here!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_NeverLeaveWithoutGameBoy
text: You never know when and where people will challenge you. / That's why I never leave home without my GAME BOY ADVANCE.$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SnoozingPreferBattles
text: SCOTT: … … … … … … … … … … Zzz… / … … … … … Huh?! Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing! / I came to check out this POKéMON CONTEST thing. / I have to admit, it does look quite entertaining, but… / Consider me a purist--I prefer battles and tough TRAINERS. / But that's just me. / {PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT, the whole works!$

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ContestsDoTakeStrategy
text: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy to win a CONTEST. / Devising CONTEST strategies is one way of becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
text: This is our special exhibit hall.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
text: As you can plainly see, there is not a single painting on exhibit. / Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of so-called classical art. / Such classical works you can see on our ground floor. / I wish to exhibit work that is far different from the classics. / Art, after all, is not restricted to old, famous works! / This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with… / Modern and vibrant artworks of POKéMON seemingly ready to spring forth into glorious life!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
text: I beg your pardon. I didn't intend to monopolize the conversation. / Now, as you are young, and yet obviously well traveled… / You must encounter lively POKéMON and works of art depicting them. / If you were to come across such a painting, may we ask you to obtain the artist's permission to exhibit it here?$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
text: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with modern and vibrant paintings of POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
text: Thanks to you, we've added a new painting to our collection! / I've heard it depicts your POKéMON. Truly magnificent! / Thank you so very, very much!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
text: Ah! It's you! {PLAYER}!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
text: Isn't this marvelous? This collection of paintings! / Each one of them flawless! None better than another! / These paintings have attracted more guests to our ART MUSEUM. / Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}. This is my dream come true!$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
text: This is merely a token of my gratitude.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
text: I will keep this for you until we meet again.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
text: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}! / It's an honor to have you visit us on your busy journeys. / Please, relax and do enjoy your visit with us.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with pink-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with yellow-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with blue-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with red-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
text: It's a picture frame with green-colored adornments.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
text: It's a painting of POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
text: I've been away awhile, so the new paintings up here surprised me. / I wish someone would paint my POKéMON this pretty.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
text: Well… So this is where they show the topical POKéMON paintings. / I see, these new paintings are indeed rather amusing.$

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
text: Wow, is that right? These paintings are of your POKéMON. / Isn't that just the ultimate joy for a TRAINER?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
text: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before. / Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST! / My abilities scare even me…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
text: I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work. / If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals. / But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
text: That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S. / Can you win if you had that many of those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
text: Whoa, isn't this place humongous! / The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
text: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their TRAINERS, are you ready?! / Give it your best showing! Let's appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
text: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST? / Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
text: Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST. / I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST… / Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
text: I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart. / It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON. / My dear wife, are you seeing this?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
text: There it is! / If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
text: Oh, dear, no! / My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over! / But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
text: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
text: Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals. / It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
text: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
text: When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS. / That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
text: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
text: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty! / Why, I almost forgot to score them!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
text: A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it. / Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
text: Waaaah! / I brushed and groomed my POKéMON carefully for this CONTEST… / But I overdid it… My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly… / What should I do?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
text: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it. / Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
text: This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger. / Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking. / Did I say something funny?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
text: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
text: Wahahahah! / Will you take a gander at all those pretty POKéMON! I just love this sort of glitz!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
text: You can't always win on just beauty alone. / You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
text: MC: Uh-oh! Hello! We're in the middle of a CONTEST! / Please enter at our registration counter and come out, okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
text: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals! / Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
text: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was distracted by another POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
text: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, but put it in a CONTEST and look out!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
text: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance. / I won't let anyone disturb its performance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
text: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute. / However, if my POKéMON were to make a cute appeal… / I'm sure that it would be so much  cuter than the others.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
text: My child is in this CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
text: Come on, dear. Go for it! Your POKéMON is the best!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
text: I think that girl over there is the cutest of the lot. / What's that? They're judging POKéMON by their looks?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
text: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, they make we want to get my own! / I'm going to go catch some!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
text: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
text: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
text: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
text: Uh… Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER. / I can make POKéMON forget their moves. / Would you like me to do that?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
text: Which POKéMON should forget a move?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
text: Which move should be forgotten?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
text: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move so it can't be forgotten…$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
text: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? That move should be forgotten?$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
text: It worked to perfection! / {STR_VAR_1} has forgotten {STR_VAR_2} completely.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
text: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
text: What? No EGG should know any moves.$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
text: Hm! / Your {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing to forget SURF.$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
text: POKéMON are partners to people. They aren't our tools. / Unfortunately, there are some people who fail to understand that…$

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
text: KECLEON: Ruroro?$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
text: Huh? What? What's that? / I'm not near awake yet… You can have this…$

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
text: Yawn… / Sleep is essential for good health… Sleep and regain health…$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
text: Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone? But you're so young! Good for you! / I'm sure my kids could learn a thing or two from you! / Me? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S. / If I get serious just a little, why, I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S. / Would you like to learn from me, a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure
text: Oh? Are you sure? / You shouldn't always try to do everything by yourself, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
text: Oh, good! You're a smart soul! This is a bit long, so listen up! / Are you ready? / If you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see that they are rated on how they feel. / The lower the feel rating, the better it is. Don't forget this! / A good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel rating and a high level. / A POKéMON can eat more good {POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too. / And this is important. / If you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, use different kinds of BERRIES. / Don't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S. / And another thing. / The more people blending BERRIES, the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S. / That's why you should talk to other people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together. / That's about all you need to know to make good {POKEBLOCK}S. / If everyone had POKéMON they love, smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family, the world would be a happier place. / Don't give up, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuadruplets
text: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets, you bet I was shocked. / But, now, seeing them play together, it makes me happy.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMultiBattles
text: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know I'm going to win.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRecordCorner
text: We like mixing stuff at the RECORD CORNER. / But what gets mixed up?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
text: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S with a BERRY BLENDER!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterContest
text: I want to brag about how tough my POKéMON is, so we're going to enter a CONTEST together.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
text: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
text: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT STORE, I always end up buying all sorts of things because it's so fun.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
text: Today, my mom is going to buy me some nice furniture.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
text: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL as a reward for winning a CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
text: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER     LOTTERY CORNER / 2F: TRAINER'S ZONE / 3F: BATTLE COLLECTION / 4F: MOVE STUDY / 5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR / ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
text: Wireless Communication is a lot of fun, isn't it? / I think it lets you do things that weren't possible before. / For instance, you can now trade with people you couldn't before. / I think it's going to be exciting!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
text: I want to spread the word about how fun Wireless Communication can be.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
text: This place is full of cute DOLLS. / I should buy some for me, instead of just for my children.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
text: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON, so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
text: They sell many cute MATS here. / I wonder which one I should get? Maybe I'll buy them all…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
text: I think they closed the rooftop because the weather is wild today.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_SetDatesForClearOutSales
text: Don't they have set dates for their clear-out sales? / I watch TV, but they never show any commercials.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BeenWaitingForClearOutSale
text: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for this clear-out sale. / They have unusual decorations today. I'm going to load up, that I am!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_BoneDryThirsty
text: Ohh… I'm bone-dry thirsty!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_WhichDrinkWouldYouLike
text: It's a VENDING MACHINE. Which drink would you like?$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_CanOfDrinkDroppedDown
text: Clang! / A can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_ExtraCanOfDrinkDroppedDown
text: Clang! / Score! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down!$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: Not enough money…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text_DecidedAgainstBuyingDrink
text: Decided against buying a drink.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyfriendInFortree
text: My little sister exchanges MAIL with her boyfriend in FORTREE. / I don't envy her one bit at all.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesMailBackAndForth
text: Even though I can't see my friend in FORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL back and forth for us. / I'm not lonesome, even though we're apart.$

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_Wingull
text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLeaderDuoFormidable
text: The GYM LEADERS in this town are a formidable duo. / Their combination attacks are, like, excellent and wow!$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AbilitiesMightChangeMoves
text: Depending on the special abilities of POKéMON, some moves might change or not work at all.$

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman5
text: If I win a whole lot of link battles and show everyone how good I am, I might get a fan following!$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
text: REVIVE is fantastic! / Give it to a fainted POKéMON, and the POKéMON will arise. / But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore the used-up PP of moves.$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLongest
text: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away. / Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts the longest.$

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
text: NET and DIVE BALLS specialize in different kinds of hunts. / A NET BALL excels against BUG- and WATER-type POKéMON. / A DIVE BALL excels while surfing, fishing, or exploring underwater.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
text: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}… / As you can see, there's not much here, but this is my home. / Thank you for all that you've done. / This is my token of appreciation. It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE. / No need to be shy--you've earned this HM.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
text: STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you should notice dark patches of water. / Use DIVE if you come to deep water like it. You'll drop to the seafloor. / When you want to come back up, use DIVE again. / In some places, it won't be possible for you to surface, though. / AQUA took the submarine to a cavern. Search south on ROUTE 128. / Use DIVE in the dark water to find the SEAFLOOR CAVERN and stop ARCHIE.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
text: STEVEN: Search south on ROUTE 128. Use DIVE in the dark water. / Find the SEAFLOOR CAVERN where AQUA took the submarine, and stop ARCHIE.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
text: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL. / It contained the POKéMON BELDUM. / Take the POKé BALL?$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ObtainedBeldum
text: {PLAYER} obtained a BELDUM.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceForAnotherMon
text: There is no space for another POKéMON.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeBallWhereItWas
text: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where it was.$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
text: It's a letter. / … … … … … … / To {PLAYER}{KUN}… / I've decided to do a little soul- searching and train on the road. / I don't plan to return home for some time. / I have a favor to ask of you. / I want you to take the POKé BALL on the desk. / Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite POKéMON. / I'm counting on you. / May our paths cross someday. / STEVEN STONE$

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_CollectionOfRareRocks
text: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by STEVEN.$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_EventScript_MegaGift_VENUSAURITE_Text
text: I found this while tending flowers. It seems to answer a Venusaur. / Keep gathering berries as you travel. The Berry Master trades stones, too.$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
text: You're the first TRAINER I've seen who deploys POKéMON so masterfully. / But, I should tell you--my son is stronger than you. / He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge, I'll have you know.$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveBerries
text: You defeated all four of us without a chance to rest. That's remarkable! / Take these berries from our garden. You have earned a little harvest.$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
text: Plant those berries or save them for the BERRY MASTER on ROUTE 123.$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
text: Mommy is stronger than Daddy. / I'm stronger than Mommy. / And Grandma's stronger than me! / But my big brother is even stronger than Grandma.$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
text: There's no question that you're strong. / But if you were to battle my grandson, you'd end up crying in frustration. / He's much stronger than any TRAINER our family knows. / He must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now. / Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
text: My grandson must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now. / Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
text: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up. Would you like to be on it?$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
text: Please step this way.$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
text: Please ride with us another time.$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
text: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down. Would you like to be on it?$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
text: Please step this way.$

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
text: Please ride with us another time.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
text: My brother dug up this Metal Coat. / It evolves Onix or Scyther when used.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
text: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a cave, you're returned to the entrance… / Old peat has another use: use a PEAT BLOCK on URSARING at night to evolve it into URSALUNA, anywhere in HOENN. / The free Evolution Items archive supplies PEAT BLOCKS once you have the MEGA RING.$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
text: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the display case…$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
text: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA… HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND… STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK… / It's crammed with books.$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
text: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! / I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… When I get engrossed in research, things end up this way… / This is embarrassing… Please keep this a secret in exchange for this.$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
text: May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System? / You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
text: It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES. / Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each. / Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system. / Keep reading?$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
text: A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize. / The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON. / Keep reading?$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
text: When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last. / If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX. / In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
text: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
text: There's an e-mail from someone on the PC. / “… … … … … … … / “Your Storage System offers more convenience than mine. / “It has a lot of user-friendly features that make it fun and useful, too. / “It makes me proud that I played a part in its development. / “Here's hoping that you'll continue research in Storage Systems. / “From BILL … … … … … … … …”$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_CatchingCharmGift
text: First-time visitors get a CATCHING CHARM. Carry it and your throws will land critical captures more often.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_MoveSpecialist
text: I once guarded the secret of DRAGON ASCENT here. / The POKéMON CENTER specialist now teaches every legal move.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
text: This is where we DRAGON users do our training. / The CHAMPION even visits. Now do you see how special it is here?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
text: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
text: With the FEATHER BADGE and REGIROCK recorded as caught, REGIDRAGO can appear on this floor. / It has a 1% wild encounter chance. SWEET SCENT raises that to 25%. / DEVON's guide lists the discoveries in the other METEOR FALLS rooms.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
text: I want to know more about your power. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
text: Since we met, we have trained hard with our sights on number one. / Help us see how much stronger we've become!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
text: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
text: You've obviously kept up your POKéMON training. / So long as you remain strong, I, too, can become stronger!$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
text: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
text: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
text: JOHN: We've been married for fifty years. / Come to think of it, I've yet to beat my dear wife in a battle.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
text: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER! / Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
text: JOHN: Young TRAINER, may we trade notes on teamwork through MATCH CALL?$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
text: JAY: We've been married for fifty years. / The bond we share as a couple could never be broken.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
text: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
text: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… / If we ever argued, we always settled it with a POKéMON battle…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
text: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER? / If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
text: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
text: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
text: JOHN: Married for fifty years… / On reflection, the dear wife and I, we battled day in and day out…$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
text: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER! / Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
text: JAY: We've been married for fifty years. / We've supported each other all that time. We've made ourselves strong.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat
text: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
text: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… Many things have happened. / I hope that we will continue to make happy memories together.$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
text: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER? / If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
text: Hey, you. It gets awfully dark ahead. It'll be tough trying to explore. / That guy who came by earlier… STEVEN, I think it was. / He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought to be all right, but… / Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those that we meet is our motto. / Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
text: That HM registers FLASH as a field technique for your team. / It lights up even the inky darkness of caves. / With DEWFORD's GYM BADGE, caves light up as you enter them!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_VialChanseyAshenWoods
text: Blob vanished into ASHEN WOODS. The HEAL BALL is still warm.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
text: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS… / Now this is what I've always wanted in a mountain. / This jagged bumpiness… It rocks my soul!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricDefeat
text: Losing left me bitter!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
text: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON… / But, when it comes to the love of the mountains, I have you beat!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro
text: This place isn't your casual hike. It's not suited for a picnic.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat
text: Ohhh, no! The ground is too bumpy…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle
text: Did you know? / Some people cleverly ride their bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister
text: Will you ever be back in this area? If you return, share what you've learned.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro
text: Picnics are fun wherever you go. Just like POKéMON!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat
text: I only lost because the ground is too bumpy!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch
text: I'll forget about losing and just enjoy this bumpy hike.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro
text: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on. It's a good place for training.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat
text: It was all over while we were still trying to find a good footing…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle
text: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to jump ledges.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister
text: When I get more used to this bumpiness, I'll send you my best climbing tips! / Can you register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro
text: I got used to this bumpiness. I sing while I climb now.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat
text: It's still not easy to battle on this bumpy ground…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch
text: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL in MAUVILLE CITY…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
text: Wah! What are you doing up here? / What am I doing up here? Guarding a path. Badly, apparently. Fight me!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat
text: Urrrgh… Should've ducked into the HIDEOUT while I could.$

label: JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant
text: Okay, oh-kay! I admit it--you're strong! / Don't worry about me. Go wherever you want!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponseToEmblem
text: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response to the MAGMA EMBLEM!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro
text: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot down the mountain in one go!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat
text: I feel like I'm falling apart…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle
text: My bicycle bounced around so much, my rear end's sore…$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro
text: I climb this hill every day. I have confidence in my strength!$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnDefeat
text: Hmm… What went wrong?$

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle
text: What is that odd rock protrusion a little up the hill from here?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
text: The rich atmosphere of the mountain has elevated my psychic power! / A mere child like you… You dream of winning?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
text: I drown in self-pity…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
text: My psychic powers have surely grown several times, but…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
text: Ahahahaha! / This is no place for children, least of all you!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
text: I lost that cleanly…$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
text: This means my training is still not enough… / I've got to keep working toward the summit… / Go, me!$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
text: Why have you come here?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
text: That was amazing! You're a very special TRAINER.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
text: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now. / And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future… / They are all to be equally cherished. Please remember that.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
text: I would like to see your POKéMON when they grow up some more… / Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
text: Oh, it's you… / Have you come to show me your grown POKéMON?$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
text: How amazing! You are a special person.$

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
text: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now. / And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future… / They are all to be equally cherished. I see that you've remembered that.$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
text: What? What? What do you want with  TEAM AQUA? / Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to snatch something important! / … … Where did he go? / Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
text: What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? / I hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to awaken an awesome POKéMON at their HIDEOUT. / But where might their HIDEOUT be?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
text: What? What? What do you want with  TEAM AQUA? / Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to jack a submarine! / … … Where did he go? / Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
text: What? What? What do you want with  TEAM AQUA? / Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122! / … … Why did he go? / Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
text: What? What? Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? / I hear that TEAM MAGMA is after an awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY. / But what is that POKéMON like?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
text: What? What? What do you want with TEAM AQUA? / Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY! / … … Why did he go? / Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell you something that crucial?$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Ayiyiyi! Suspicious character! / Right, right, procedure. TENTACRUEL, DHELMISE, hold the gate!$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Grrrr… I lost it! I lost the gate!$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: I did my part. The rest of the crew is deeper in, and they're better than me.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
text: MATT: You crossed the entire hideout before the tide changed. Impressive. / ARCHIE needs one final current of time. My job is to make every turn cost you.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
text: You refused every delay I offered…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
text: MATT: You won the battle. ARCHIE still finished the dive sequence.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
text: MATT: ARCHIE is headed for a cavern beneath ROUTE 128. / Still chasing him? Surf east from LILYCOVE to MOSSDEEP and earn its BADGE. / Then ask STEVEN at his house in the northwest of MOSSDEEP about DIVE. / By the time you can reach the seafloor, ARCHIE will have what he came for!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Waiting is part of an ambush. You finally entered the current I was assigned.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: You turned my ambush back on me…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: The delay still served ARCHIE. Whether it was enough is happening below us now.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
text: Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride and joy! / Every panel changes your position and every battle changes your resources. / AQUA wins by making the field move.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
text: What's wrong with you? You're not tired at all!$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
text: That reminds me… I can't remember where I put the MASTER BALL. / If I fail to guard it, our BOSS will chew me out…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
text: First thing they taught me here was how the warp panels connect. / Second thing was doubles. I'm better at the panels.$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
text: Too busy thinking about panels…$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
text: I'll learn to battle properly. Someday. The panels are just more fun.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
text: SHELLY: You reached the seafloor without our submarine. I expected no less. / At the INSTITUTE you read the weather. Here the cavern itself changes the field. / Read the current before it closes.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
text: You mapped the current while inside it…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
text: You would have been formidable in AQUA. / But you keep choosing balance over our freedom. ARCHIE waits beyond this room.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: AQUA needs POKéMON to reach a current human tools cannot follow. / Your team carried you just as far. Only one formation advances.$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Your formation held deeper…$

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: We followed ARCHIE because his dream made motion sound like freedom. / You came this deep to ask whether a world without limits can survive.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
text: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}! / Surprised? I made it here, and it's because of you. / Losing in MAUVILLE showed me my team had no answer for speed. Now TOGEKISS pulls every attack while the rest set up. / I'm not losing anymore. Here I come!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
text: You still had an answer for my answer…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, but I saw the seam in my team. / Next time it's closed.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
text: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}! / I rebuilt again since last time. I wanted you to see it first! / Okay… Here I come!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
text: You still had an answer for my answer…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
text: WALLY: Not this time either… But the gap is closing, {PLAYER}. / When it closes, I'm taking the LEAGUE.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
text: I've made it this far a couple times, but the last stretch is so long…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
text: My dream ends here again…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text: You've made it this far. Keep the momentum going and become the CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you! / A victory-shaped mark nearby sketches LUCARIO. Keep that family close.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
text: I didn't come all this way to lose now. That possibility doesn't exist!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
text: Impossible… I lost?$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
text: I lost here… / That means I lack the qualifications to become the CHAMPION…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
text: This seemingly infinite and harsh road lives up to its name of VICTORY.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
text: Your battle style is fantastic…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
text: You seem to have the potential for becoming the CHAMPION.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
text: What is the VICTORY ROAD? I'll tell you if you win!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
text: Okay! Well done!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
text: Getting through here safely--that's the final test for any TRAINER aiming to become the POKéMON CHAMPION. / That's why it's called the VICTORY ROAD.$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
text: I have nothing to say to anyone that's come this far. Come on!$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
text: This is a disgrace…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
text: Humph, go right on ahead. See if I care.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_RegionalEvolutions
text: Level DEWOTT anywhere in SHOAL CAVE at Lv. 36 or higher for Hisuian SAMUROTT. / Level BERGMITE in the low-tide ice room at Lv. 37 or higher for Hisuian AVALUGG. / Elsewhere they take their usual forms. Galarian MR. MIME also lives in that ice room. It becomes MR. RIME at Lv. 42.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
text: Your focus overcame the cold! / Take this Deep Sea Scale.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
text: Everything starts with focus!$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked.$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UseBasementKey
text: Use the BASEMENT KEY?$

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
text: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY. / The door opened!$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
text: The generator is radiating heat that can be felt even at a distance. / It looks like it should be turned off as soon as possible.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
text: The generator quieted down.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
text: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch. / Click… / … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … / The generator appears to have stopped…$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRestarted
text: Bzzzt! Something laughed inside the generator, and it restarted itself!$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRestartedAgain
text: The same cry rings through the plant. / Whatever is inside wants a battle.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomAppears
text: The generator bursts open! ROTOM challenges your team!$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomRemains
text: ROTOM slips back into the generator. It is still waiting for your answer.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomCaught
text: The ROTOM CATALOG changes ROTOM into its five appliances. / With the BALANCE BADGE, MELTAN can appear among this plant's wild POKéMON. / Finish WATTSON's generator job and report back to add ZERAORA. Catch REGISTEEL to add REGIELEKI too. / The FEATHER BADGE then adds ZEKROM. Each is a 1% encounter; SWEET SCENT gives 25%, shared among those available.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosDormant
text: ZAPDOS watches over the generator. Return with the BALANCE BADGE to challenge it.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosNeedsPartner
text: ZAPDOS accepts challengers with the BALANCE BADGE. No partner species is required.$

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosAwakens
text: ZAPDOS crackles with electricity! It accepts your challenge!$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
text: Urrrrppp… / I'm getting queasy just being aboard this ship… / It's not even moving, but…$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
text: This is a perfect place to go exploring! It's exciting here! / I bet there're amazing treasures on board.$

label: AbandonedShip_Room_B1F_Text_PutKeystoneInTrash
text: The ODD KEYSTONE fits the cracked socket in this old bin. / A whisper rises from the hull. Set the stone in place?$

label: AbandonedShip_Room_B1F_Text_KeystoneMissing
text: Cold air seeps from the old bin. / A cracked socket in its base looks made for an ODD KEYSTONE.$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
text: I'm investigating this ship on behalf of CAPT. STERN. / He also asked me to find a SCANNER, but I haven't had any success…$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
text: Oh! That's a SCANNER! / Listen, can I get you to deliver that to CAPT. STERN? / I want to investigate this ship a little more.$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIsSSCactus
text: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS. It seems to be from an earlier era.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm1DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked. / “RM. 1” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm2DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked. / “RM. 2” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm4DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked. / “RM. 4” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm6DoorIsLocked
text: The door is locked. / “RM. 6” is painted on the door.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_InsertedKey
text: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the KEY. / The inserted KEY stuck fast, but the door opened.$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
text: It's bright and shiny! But it's just trash…$

label: SealedChamber_InnerRoom_Text_RegigigasStatue
text: It's a statue of a Pokémon. It exudes tremendous power… / There's something engraved on it…$

label: SealedChamber_InnerRoom_Text_RegigigasECAwakens
text: The three REGIS answer together! The colossal statue begins to move!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoDormant
text: ARTICUNO rests in the frozen chamber. Return with the FEATHER BADGE to challenge it.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoNeedsPartner
text: ARTICUNO accepts challengers with the FEATHER BADGE. No partner species is required.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoAwakens
text: ARTICUNO spreads its icy wings! It accepts your challenge!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Every guard has one fixed position. Mine is this corner and this approach. / MAXIE says order fails when one person abandons their place. I will hold mine.$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: I held the position, but not the battle…$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: A fixed post is useless if the opponent can change every approach.$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Our leader told us to dig into MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug. / We found something beneath the mountain that could change HOENN forever. / Beat my formation and see for yourself!$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: The entrance line has fallen…$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: The chamber is deeper in. What MAXIE woke there may already be moving.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
text: Nothing personal. I'm following orders, and my orders are: nobody passes.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
text: Orders, meet reality…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
text: We dug up something huge down here, and MAXIE has the BLUE ORB now. / I don't know what happens next. I don't think he does either.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
text: I used to hate this heat. Then MAGMORTAR taught me to wear it like armor.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
text: Even armor buckles under pressure…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
text: Maybe TEAM MAGMA suits me after all. I just need a stronger furnace.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
text: You feel those tremors? People say it's the volcano. Some of us know better. / Whoops! Never mind. Fight me!$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
text: You hit like a volcano yourself…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
text: You won this one. Doesn't matter. MAGMA's almost there. I hope.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
text: Wait. One of ours dropped his MAGMA EMBLEM outside. Was it you who found it? / Doesn't matter. You're still not getting past FLYGON.$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
text: I'm having trouble believing this…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
text: Between you and me? I've got a feeling this plan ends badly for everyone.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
text: I understand everything our leader says. But you know what? / Doing stuff like digging up a super- ancient POKéMON and ripping off someone's METEORITE… / I think we're going a little too far. What do you think?$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
text: Yeah, I think we are doing something wrong somehow.$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
text: You know, losing to you cleared my mind. / The next time I see our leader, I'm going to ask him about what we do.$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
text: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
text: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
text: STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm amazed you knew where to find me. / Do you, uh…maybe think of me as just a rock maniac? / No, that can't be right. / We battled alongside each other at the MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER. / You should have a very good idea about how good I am. / Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount a serious challenge, expect the worst!$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefeat
text: You… I had no idea you'd become so strong…$

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
text: STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since our paths first crossed in GRANITE CAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling. / I thought that you would eventually become the CHAMPION. / My predictions usually come true. / And where will you go from here? / … … … … … … … … … … … … / Fufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
text: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of cleaning this huge place! / Let's have a quick battle!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
text: Little bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! / The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
text: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. There's plenty of room. It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
text: Big bro, I lost!$

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
text: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! / The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
text: There's a bed… Let's take a rest.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro
text: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY. / I enjoy attending CONTESTS, you see.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonDefeat
text: That was an enjoyable match!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle
text: I get so excited imagining what kinds of POKéMON I'll get to see in the next CONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahIntro
text: Are your friends strong?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahDefeat
text: Your friends are, indeed, strong.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle
text: Friends need not be human. For me, POKéMON are treasured friends!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro
text: Child… Did you knock on the door?$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat
text: A loss is to be accepted without haste or panic.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle
text: To be never ruffled in any situation is the GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro
text: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedDefeat
text: JED: Sigh…$

label: SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle
text: JED: It's the first time that our lovey- dovey power couldn't prevail! You must be an awesome TRAINER!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
text: Here, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves. / Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what. / Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm. / Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes. / Due to its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using. / It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
text: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe. / There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on. / There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and  paralysis. / POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger

text: … … …Kaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
text: SPENSER: Well, that was some display! Even fully unleashed, my brethren could not overpower you. / Your team spirit is truly admirable! / Here! Bring me that thing, will you?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
text: My, my, if only you could maintain a certain level of decorum… / Gaaah, here! Hurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Spirits Symbol took on a golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
text: SPENSER: Gwahahah! / Come see me time and again! My brethren and I will be waiting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
text: Where the courage of TRAINERS is put to the test! / Welcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID! / I am your guide to the Battle Quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge
text: Have you the courage to embark on the Battle Quest challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge
text: We await your challenge in the future!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
text: The Battle Quest is a battling event in which you must explore the PYRAMID and try to reach the top. / In the PYRAMID are seven floors of mazes, all of them filled with not only skilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON. / You must enter with three POKéMON, none of them holding an item. / On your ascent, you will be provided with a BATTLE BAG for items. / If you fail in your challenge, any item placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears. / If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must select “REST” and save the game. / If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
text: The PYRAMID offers two courses, Level 50 and Open Level. Which will you enter?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
text: Very good. Now, please select the three POKéMON you wish to accompany you.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
text: A slight problem, adventurer! / You seem to not have the three POKéMON qualified for the challenge. / Please also remember to take all items from your POKéMON. / EGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
text: A slight problem, adventurer! / You seem to not have the three POKéMON qualified for the challenge. / The three POKéMON must be different and each no higher than Level 50. / Please also remember to take all items from your POKéMON. / EGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
text: When you are ready, please have a word with me.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
text: Before you enter the BATTLE PYRAMID, the game must be saved. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ShowYouIntoPyramid
text: Very good. I will now show you into the BATTLE PYRAMID.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WeWillHoldBagForSafekeeping
text: We will hold your BAG for safekeeping, {PLAYER}, while you are exploring.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakePreviousBattleBag

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakeThisBattleBag
text: In exchange, please take this BATTLE BAG.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExchangedBagForBattleBag

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid
text: Excellent to see you back! / You've conquered the PYRAMID! How splendid!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HeldItemsMovedToBag

text: We look forward to your next challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
text: We have been looking forward to your arrival! / Here is your prize for conquering the PYRAMID.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
text: Welcome… / I shall be pleased to tell you what misfortunes await in the PYRAMID…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
text: I see a shower of sparks… / …And in it, I see your POKéMON struggling with paralysis…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
text: I see poison… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from the effects of poison…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
text: I see bright red flames… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from burns…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
text: I sense the tremendous pressure of unrequited anger… / It is a curse… / …And, I see your POKéMON drained of Power Points and having no recourse but to use STRUGGLE…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
text: I see POKéMON loftily airborne… / …And, I see your POKéMON frustrated by powerless GROUND-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
text: I sense terrific energy rising from the ground below… / …And, I see your POKéMON unable to escape the power's clutches…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
text: I see ICE-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON fighting the freezing effects of ice…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
text: I see a flurry of moves that imperil the user… / …And, I see your POKéMON falling to them…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
text: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON in torment from PSYCHIC moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
text: I see ROCK-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from ROCK moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
text: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON pummeled by FIGHTING moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
text: RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY… SANDSTORM… HAIL… / I see POKéMON that become stronger with the weather… / …And, I see your POKéMON confounded by different types of moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
text: I see BUG-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from different kinds of attacks…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
text: I see DARK-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from DARK-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
text: I see WATER-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from WATER-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost
text: I see GHOST-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from GHOST-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel
text: I see STEEL-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
text: I see flying POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
text: I see those that have evolved from the power of stones… / I also sense fire, water, and electricity… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from those three powers…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
text: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON… / …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
text: Whether you believe my fortunes or not, the choice is yours… / The future can be changed anytime… I wish you safe passage…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
text: The old PYRAMID was a maze. Now I study the CIRCUIT here. / Its opponents can punish a careless switch just as quickly as a careless attack.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
text: I used to worry about losing items in the old PYRAMID. / The CIRCUIT restores my team and held items after each match. I can focus on the battle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
text: Welcome back! You've done the unthinkable! / You've defeated the PYRAMID KING and conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
text: Young explorer! In commendation of your courage, we give you these Battle Point(s)!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
text: The Battle Quest rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
text: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text: When the PYRAMID is conquered, the wild POKéMON that appear in it are replaced by different kinds. / Explore, observe, and learn what kinds of wild POKéMON you may encounter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
text: TRAINERS are lying in wait for you inside the PYRAMID. / On each floor, there are up to eight TRAINERS. / When you defeat a TRAINER, you will get a helpful hint for your adventure.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
text: The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange themselves every time you enter it. / The mazes are poorly lit. You must advance with caution. / The light grows brighter whenever you defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
text: The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG while in the PYRAMID. / There are two separate BATTLE BAGS-- one each for the Level 50 and Open Level adventures. / They each can hold up to 99 pieces of ten kinds of items. / The contents of the BATTLE BAG are lost if you fail in your quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_CircuitObserver
text: I once read the PYRAMID's omens. / The CIRCUIT asks a different question: how will your team answer the board before it? / A prediction helps. A sound fallback helps even more.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
text: It is a delight to see you here! You have reached the summit of the BATTLE PYRAMID! / Above here is the PYRAMID's lookout point. / It is a place open only to those who have conquered the PYRAMID. / Now, please! Up you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
text: The PYRAMID's new conqueror! Let the name {PLAYER} be known!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
text: It is a delight to see you here! / Unfortunately, you were second by a mere fraction of time! / Our chief has already conquered the PYRAMID ahead of you. / However, my young explorer… You are a TRAINER! / Assert your power and take the glory of the pinnacle from our chief! / Now, please! When you are ready, take one more step of courage!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
text: Young adventurer… / Wouldn't you agree that explorations are the grandest of adventures? / Your own wits! / Your own strength! / Your own POKéMON! / And, above all, only your own courage to lead you through unknown worlds…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
text: Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand! Grand, it is! Eh? / I'm BRANDON! / I'm the PYRAMID KING, which means I'm in charge here. / Most people call me the chief! / You coming here means you have that much confidence in yourself, am I right? / Hahahah! This should be exciting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
text: Now, then! Bring your courage to our battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
text: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was! Grand, yes, indeed! / Well done! You've earned recognition! Your FRONTIER PASS, please!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
text: The Brave Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
text: Young explorer! I look forward to our next meeting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
text: BRANDON: …You've finally returned, young explorer… / Your love of adventure seems to come deep from within your heart… / Yes… You are exactly as I was in my own youth… / … … …Ah… / The passionate! / The dangerous! / The desperate! / Those days of death-defying, life-affirming adventures are back…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
text: Now, then! / I sense my own courage is off the meter!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
text: Everything you have! I'm braced for it all!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
text: BRANDON: Hahahah! Remarkable! Yes, it's grand, indeed! / Young explorer! / You've bested me through and through! Here! I want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Brave Symbol took on a golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
text: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that I have much to learn still! / May our paths cross again! Farewell for now, young explorer!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
text: Now, when you are ready, take courage and step forward.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
text: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS is put to the test! / I welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA! / I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
text: Now, do you wish to take the BATTLE ARENA challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
text: In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake the Set KO Tourney. / All participants enter with a team of three POKéMON. / The three POKéMON must be lined up in the order in which they are to appear. / During battle, the POKéMON will appear one at a time in the preset order. / Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must remain out until the match is decided. / If a match remains undecided in three turns, it goes to judging. / If you wish to interrupt your challenge, please save the game. / If you don't save, you will not be able to continue with your challenge. / If you pull off the feat of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
text: Before showing you to the BATTLE ARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
text: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?$

text: My dear challenger! / You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry. / To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON. / The three different POKéMON must all be Level 50 or lower. / They also must not hold the same kinds of items. / EGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

text: I protected every turn and never built a winning position. / Next time, my defensive choices need to create an opportunity.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
text: Your first two Pokémon begin the Circuit battle together. / Make the opening pair support one another, and keep useful answers in reserve.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
text: The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles. / First, one battle lasts only three turns. / If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging. / The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled. / Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
text: The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were. / The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
text: The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used. / If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up. / If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered. / If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.” / The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT. / If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
text: The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle. / The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
text: A victory snatched from the ARENA TYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep! / We congratulate you on your most splendid challenge!$

text: SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome! Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space. / Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER. / This is my dream come true. It took me years and years, but I've finally given shape to my dream.$

I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves. / But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
text: Buhahaha! / Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Fine, fine, look here! Which move should I teach?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
text: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
text: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON I should teach the move to.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
text: What the… You haven't got enough Battle Points!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
text: Do you see how skilled I am now? I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
text: What's that? You don't want to… / If you want to see how skilled I am, you come see me anytime!$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
text: Ihihihi! / I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER. / I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you! / … … … … … … / What's wrong? You don't believe me. / I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced! / I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves. / But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
text: Ihihihi! / Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
text: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along. / But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
text: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful. / They were idols among us TRAINERS. / Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities. / In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished. / But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this… / Time is so cruel…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
text: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
text: Inflicts damage identical to the user's level.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
text: Recovers half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
text: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
text: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
text: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
text: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
text: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
text: Sprays star- shaped rays that never miss.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
text: A chilling attack that lowers the foe's SPEED.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
text: Endures any at- tack for 1 turn, leaving 1HP.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
