label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
text: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
text: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
text: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorFree
text: Buhahaha! I still know a thing or two about beautiful moves. / The lessons are free now. Let us prepare your team.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorFree
text: Ihihihi! Experience makes every move worth another look. / The lessons are free now. Let us prepare your team.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
text: What a TRAINER needs… / Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability… / Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building! / Huh? POKéMON? What's that?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
text: Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS? / That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
text: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling! / I like POKéMON CONTESTS more! / But I'm no good at CONTESTS! / I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
text: There was someone here using a  POKéMON I've never seen before. / I never learned about it at TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least. / I wonder where you can catch POKéMON like that.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
text: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA! I'd better get the right POKéMON from the PC Storage System.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
text: I'm bringing SKITTY on my next Circuit team! / Five partners will help this little one find its chance.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
text: We came here to chaperon our grandson. / But since we're here, we thought we should get some souvenirs.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_CaptureBallsMakeNiceGift
text: Dear, what do you think of this? Wouldn't these BALLS make a nice gift? / Our grandson is always searching for one more teammate.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
text: Trainer battles here don't allow items from the BAG. / Prepare held items before entering the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT.$

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
text: The feeling of being watched faded…$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
text: This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS. / Unfortunately, we're still getting things ready. Please come back later!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
text: Welcome! / This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
text: Is this your first visit here? / Before you enter, please save your game.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
text: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are… / Up to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
text: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are… / There appear to be TRAINERS gathered in every room.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
text: Would you like to challenge the waiting TRAINERS?$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
text: I will time your progress. Best of luck! / On your marks… / Get set… / Go!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
text: Please do visit us again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
text: That was too bad. / I think you put in a tremendous effort in your battling. / Please come back and try again!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
text: I hope you give it your best.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
text: When the TRAINERS switch places, the movement can be hectic. / To avoid the stampede, we moved the reception counter here. / I'm sorry for the inconvenience.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
text: Thank you for playing!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
text: Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct an event called the Time Attack. / It is a race that measures how long you take to reach our owner on the rooftop from this counter. / The fastest times are posted on the Time Board--try competing with your friends. / In TRAINER battles along the way, neither Exp. Points nor money will be awarded.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have only one POKéMON with you. / You will need at least two POKéMON to enter this event.$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
text: Hm! Hm! / You finally came! Yes, you have arrived! / Wait! Don't say it! I know why you came all the way here by yourself! / You wanted to see me, the owner of the TRAINER HILL, because… / You want to form a tag team with me! Wa-hoo! / …Uh? That's not it? / Anyway, I watched you on your way up. Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
text: For a marvelous someone like you, I have the most marvelous gift!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
text: Oh, no, full up with things! You'll be back later for this!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
text: Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get here marvelously quickly? / How splendid! You needn't have hurried so to see me! / That is so delightful. I'll have the Time Board at the reception updated!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
text: But, oh… You weren't very quick getting here.$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
text: Perhaps it would please me more if you arrived zippier next time. / Then, I should be pleased to form a tag team with you! / Until we meet again, amigo!$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
text: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but one reason and one only! / To find the most suitable partner with whom I may form a tag team!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
text: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS and POKéMON combos are ahead? / All I know is that I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
text: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this TRAINER HILL from all over. / I can't wait to test the waters! / I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
text: Do you see the Time Board over there? / My friends and I are trying to see who can reach the top in the least time.$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
text: Do you know when they're opening this place up? / I'm waiting here to be the first challenger ever!$

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
text: Would you like to return to the reception counter?$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItToMe
text: Aak! You've made it to me? Hmmm… You're sharp!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPlantTrees
text: It took me all night to plant all those trees… / You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four, five, six places!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
text: It took me all night to make the maze… / You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four, five places!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
text: It took me all night to prepare the wall panels… / You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four places!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
text: It took me all night to shove in those boulders… / You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three places!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
text: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS and another to think up the quiz… / You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two places!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
text: It took me all night to install the doors… / You're almost my equal in greatness!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
text: It took me all night setting up arrows… / You're my equal in greatness!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
text: It took me all night polishing floors… / You're above me in greatness! Possibly…$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
text: Wh-what should I do? My fountain of ideas for tricks has run dry… / Perhaps it is time I toured the country on a quest to devise new tricks…$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
text: I hate to admit defeat, but you have bested me! / Still, you must have been reeled in by my charisma for you to visit me again and again. Yes, you must have! / But that has nothing to do with my losing! / In recognition of the friendship between you, the driven, and the genius that is myself, I demand that you take this keepsake! / Actually there are two-- a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT. Which do you prefer?$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
text: What? No room in your PC? What am I to make of that? / I wish I could say that, but I am much too kind and caring, so come back later!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
text: … … … … … … / I am leaving on a journey of discovery. A quest in search of new tricks. / I wish that you will one day visit and entertain me again. / And now, farewell!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
text: Fine! You have earned this reward!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
text: What? Have you no room for this? What manner of items do you carry? / But fine, since you've reached me, your reward will be with me till later.$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
text: Scrub that smug smirk from your face! It's much too early to think you've won! / I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will. You may mock me only when you're done. / Come back for the next exciting installment!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
text: Now, now! You're ignoring me now? Now that, I consider heartbreaking!$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FinalPrizeMegaStone
text: And one more thing! A true master of tricks deserves a master of the mind.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door. / “TRICK MASTER is cool.” … … … … … … … … / The lock clicked open!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntro
text: It's too much bother to think this out. I only wanted to battle!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefeat
text: Even though I lost, I still like battling the best!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPostBattle
text: Wouldn't you agree? You would go anywhere if TRAINERS were there.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntro
text: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush aside with one finger!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefeat
text: I can push boulders, but I can't solve the puzzle…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPostBattle
text: It's not good enough to be brawny… You have to use your head. Be brainy!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaIntro
text: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier, isn't it?$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaDefeat
text: Aaak!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPostBattle
text: Has anyone made it to the end?$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door. / “TRICK MASTER is my life.” … … … … … … … … / The lock clicked open!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIntro
text: When I heard there was a strange house, I had to check it out.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaDefeat
text: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
text: I'm sure having a good time checking this place out. / It's a challenge I've found worth repeating!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyIntro
text: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON to fly over the wall…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyDefeat
text: Gwaaah! I blew it!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPostBattle
text: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because I was trying to cheat.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianIntro
text: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating doors…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianDefeat
text: Everything's spinning around and around. I can't take this anymore…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianPostBattle
text: You don't seem to be affected at all. Or do you have your poker face on?$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door. / “TRICK MASTER is huggable.” … … … … … … … … / The lock clicked open!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
text: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
text: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
text: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
text: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
text: Defeated! It's a bad sign…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
text: I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
text: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
text: Oh! Well, go ahead, then!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
text: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
text: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
text: You're so casual about winning!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
text: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
text: I ever so closely watched you coming!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
text: This outcome I didn't see coming…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
text: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird place to get acquainted. / As one weirdo to another, let's do our best!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettIntro
text: It's awfully cramped in here…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettDefeat
text: Oh, yes, strong you are.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettPostBattle
text: I was hoping to switch places with you when I beat you, but…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
text: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door. / “TRICK MASTER I love.” … … … … … … … … / The lock clicked open!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentIntro
text: Not many TRAINERS have made it this far.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentDefeat
text: That must mean you're tough, too…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentPostBattle
text: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION? That's too much!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraIntro
text: Consider yourself lucky to be battling me!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDefeat
text: This isn't right! I can't lose!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPostBattle
text: It's a miracle that you beat me. You can brag about it.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyIntro
text: You've been slugging through the TRICK HOUSE challenge, too.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDefeat
text: I see… You possess an extraordinary style.$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPostBattle
text: Seeing someone like you should please the TRICK MASTER.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
text: This area is covered in volcanic ash, huff-puff! / I'm specially gifted, huff-puff. / I make glass out of volcanic ash and make items, huff-puff. / Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
text: Just take that SOOT SACK and walk through piles of ash, huff-puff. / And it will fill up with the volcanic ash, huff-puff. / Once you think you've collected a good amount, come see me, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeCollectedAshes
text: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff? Let me see, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
text: Hmmm… There's not enough ash here, huff-puff. I can't make glass with this, huff-puff. / Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps you'll need to walk for me to make you a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
text: Oh! You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff! / I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff! Which one would you like, huff-puff?$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
text: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Is that the one for you, huff-puff?$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
text: Which one would you like, huff-puff?$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
text: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff! / Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff. Just wait a little while, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
text: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? / There's not enough ash here to make that, though, huff-puff. / Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps you'll need to walk through volcanic ash for me to make that item, huff-puff. / Which item would you rather have me make instead, huff-puff?$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
text: You've collected all that ash, but you don't want anything, huff-puff?$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
text: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}. Take it, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
text: Oh? You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff. / I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
text: Oh? You've no room in your PC, huff-puff? / I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
text: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK with you, huff-puff. / You have to keep it with you to collect volcanic ash, huff-puff.$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
text: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my boss is talking. / Huff-huff! Puff-puff!$

label: AlteringCave_1F_Text_Researcher
text: This cavern feels like a doorway. The deeper I go, the stranger it becomes. / With the BALANCE BADGE, HOOPA can appear as a 1% wild encounter here. SWEET SCENT raises it to 25%. / MEWTWO waits separately on B1F. It will challenge you with the MIND BADGE.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafIntro
text: I followed the distortions here from Kanto. They react to strong teams. / Show me whether Hoenn chose well.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafDefeat
text: It did. That was a Champion's answer.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafAfter
text: Take this MEWTWONITE X. What waits below deserves its full power.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafBagFull
text: Make room for the MEWTWONITE X. Your reward will wait here.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoDormant
text: MEWTWO is watching you. Return with the MIND BADGE to challenge it.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoNeedsPartner
text: MEWTWO accepts challengers with the MIND BADGE. No partner species is required.$

label: AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoAwakens
text: MEWTWO steps forward to challenge you!$

label: CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceIntro
text: This crystal chamber records HOENN's deepest answer to pressure. / As Champion, face my unrestricted rain exhibition. Nothing here is ceremonial.$

label: CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom_Text_WallaceDefeat
text: You found calm inside impossible rain.$
